JLPT 2026 Dates: July 5 and December 6 Registration Guide

Kanjidon Team · Jan 30, 2026

The official 2026 JLPT dates are Sunday, July 5 and Sunday, December 6. That is the only schedule shared globally. City availability, registration windows, fees, payment rules, venues and result delivery are local. Use this guide as a checklist, then complete every step through the official host for your test location.

Official 2026 Test Dates

SessionOfficial dateAvailability note
First testSunday, July 5, 2026Not offered in every overseas city
Second testSunday, December 6, 2026Not offered in every overseas city

Find the Correct Registration Authority

Inside Japan, applications are handled through the domestic process operated by Japan Educational Exchanges and Services. Outside Japan, the Japan Foundation publishes a country-and-city list of local hosts. Select your exact city; a national or nearby-city deadline may not apply to your venue.

Why This Article Does Not List One Deadline or Price

Local institutions choose their own registration period, capacity, fee, payment method and refund policy. Some sites fill before the nominal deadline. Publishing a generic “March” or “August” deadline or a US-wide price would risk sending candidates to an expired or wrong process. The current local test guide is authoritative.

Registration Checklist

  • Confirm that your city offers the session and level you want.
  • Read the local test guide before creating or reusing an account.
  • Prepare the required name spelling, photo and identification details exactly as instructed.
  • Choose one level; the schedule normally prevents taking multiple levels in the same session.
  • Pay only through the host’s official channel and save the confirmation.
  • Check when and how the test voucher will be issued.

Before Test Day

  • Verify the venue, reporting time and transport route on the latest voucher or host notice.
  • Bring the required identification, voucher and permitted writing tools.
  • Review local rules for phones, watches, food, bags and special accommodations.
  • Contact the host early if your name, photo or identification details are wrong.

Results and Certificates

Result timing and delivery differ between Japan and overseas hosts. The official 2026 guide indicates that overseas examinees receive certificates through local host institutions, with the July cycle generally reaching them in early October and the December cycle in early March. Online result access and local delivery instructions should still be confirmed with your host.

Official Sources

  • Official JLPT 2026 test dates and sections
  • Official JLPT overseas test-site and host list
  • Official JLPT 2026 guide
